card: One census kit: a fight runner with read-only observers and one report harness
guards: case 1: pre-kit fixture parity (builds 6x8, coverage, named 2x8, week cells) - pins behaviour that must not change
case 2: 200-fight fire_close digest dd746f4e from d1-exchange-after.json
case 3 hash half: armed fire_heavy week-3 lag hashes equal the pre-kit fixture (plus existing week-census.test lag digest 6f5b913b)
deviations_from_card: Premises re-verified at d3dd8c7, not 2d83a1e: the fixture was captured at d3dd8c7. Case 3: progression A already routes arms through createGames opponentMage, but the armed runWeekBuildFight still forked createGames + the loop and returned 5 fields; it now calls runBuildFight with weekOptions(week, profile, arm) (runBuildFight's week arg widened to accept opponentMage), so armed fights keep their hashes and carry casts/exchanges/cleanHits/distance/branches. Tested at week 3 steady lag on 8 seeds against the fixture. planBranches/whyLine (arena-schools-ai B) and the trace arg moved into the kit intact, re-exported from builds-census.ts. evidenceDir moved into the kit, re-exported. Case 4's grep covers the four runner files (the writers' evidence 'mode' strings legitimately say createGames(...)). Case 7 grep narrowed per the critic to the seed:hash expression in the 9 ported files; report-w4.ts, report-ladder.ts, report-w2/w3 and report-named's source-file hashOf are untouched. Observer is {step(g, events)} with readings read from the observer's closure (no finish()). Commit 1 is the fixture only so each commit stays green; the kit, its test and the ports are commit 2.
notes: One median/quantile policy: null on an empty list. Visible only in degenerate cells: builds and counters medianS are now null instead of 0 when every fight times out (writers print '-', medianInBand false); named duration summaries' p10/p50/p90 are null on an empty set (medianOutOfBand reads null as out). No committed evidence has such a cell. Evidence files written after this keep every field, but the envelope keys (label, command, seedRange, reference) now come first, and a writer run with no arguments records the command without a trailing ' -- '. Smoke-ran all five writers at count 1-2 into a temporary docs/change-requests/kitcheck folder, then deleted it. No evidence file, simulator file, hash or vector changed. core-census B's files (census-compare*, report-compare.ts, package.json) were not touched.
